summary: The ping module is a connectivity test that returns pong if Ansible can log in and run Python; it's not ICMP. Use win_ping for Windows and net_ping for network devices.
questions: How do I test that Ansible can connect to my hosts?
Is ansible ping an ICMP ping?
How do I ping Windows hosts with Ansible?
Why does ansible -m ping fail on a host without Python?

answer_card.title: Test connectivity with ping
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.ping` returns `pong` when Ansible can log in and run a usable Python. **Not ICMP.** Use it ad hoc: `ansible all -m ansible.builtin.ping`. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_ping`; network devices: `ansible.netcommon.net_ping`.
